PRIVACY POLICY

What we collect, why we collect it, and what we do with it.

Return & Refund Policy Shipping & Pickup Policy Privacy Policy Terms of Service

Last updated: October 13, 2026

The short version: We only collect what we need to make and deliver your order. We never sell your information.

Who we are

Fly Visuals, 8132 Cormel St, Port Richey, FL 34668. This policy covers products ordered from our online store.

What we collect

  • Contact details: name, email, phone number, and business name.
  • Order details: products, sizes, quantities, text, and the artwork, logos, or photos you upload.
  • Shipping details: your delivery address, if you choose shipping.
  • Basic technical data: like your browser type and IP address, which our website host and services collect automatically.

Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe. Your card number goes directly to Stripe. We never see or store it.

How we use it

  • To make, ship, and deliver your order.
  • To send proofs, order updates, and answers to your questions.
  • To send occasional offers, only if you agree. You can opt out any time.
  • To prevent fraud and keep our records as required by law.

Text messages

If you give us your phone number, we may text you about your order. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out at any time.

Who we share it with

We don't sell or rent your information. We only share it with the services that help us run the business:

  • Our payment processor (Stripe).
  • Our website host and form provider (Netlify).
  • Our customer management and messaging tools.
  • Shipping carriers, to deliver your order.
  • Authorities, if required by law.

Your artwork

Files you upload are used only to make your order. We don't use your logos or designs for anything else without your permission. We may photograph finished work for our portfolio. If you'd rather we didn't, just tell us.

Cookies

Our site uses only basic cookies and similar technology needed for the site, forms, and checkout to work. Our fonts load from Google Fonts, which may log your IP address.

How long we keep it

We keep order records as long as needed for business, tax, and warranty purposes, then delete them.

Your choices

You can ask us to see, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. Email flyvisualsfl@gmail.com and we'll respond within 30 days.

Children

Our site is not meant for children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect their information.

Changes

If we change this policy, we'll update the date at the top of this page.

Questions?

Call or text (727) 494-6162, email flyvisualsfl@gmail.com, or stop by the shop at 8132 Cormel St, Port Richey, FL 34668.
